episodes.summary: Eph investigates Kelly's disappearance and struggles with what he finds. Dutch pursues a plan to retaliate against Palmer. Fitzwilliam makes a surprising choice.

episodes.name: The Third Rail
episodes.summary: Setrakian leads Eph, Fet and Nora in the hunt for the Master's lair. Left behind at the pawnshop with Mariela, Zack risks his safety for Mariela's sake.

episodes.name: Last Rites
episodes.summary: Dutch returns with a plan to broadcast Eph's warning about the vampiric plague, but they face a new threat when Eichhorst launches his own attack against the pawn shop. Palmer receives a special visitor. Gus gears up for the on-coming fight but discovers there's another mysterious factor involved.

episodes.name: The Master
episodes.summary: Eph and Fet recon for an all-out assault that Setrakian assures them will finally kill the Master. Gus aligns himself with a strange new force, one that may swing the fight in an unforeseen direction.

episodes.name: BK, NY
episodes.summary: Setrakian risks the lives of the entire group to find information about a closely guarded secret text. The Master begins the next phase of his own plan by creating a terrifying new breed of creature and placing them under Kelly's control.

episodes.name: By Any Means
episodes.summary: Eph and Nora experiment on their newfound patients. Fet and Dutch grow closer as they clear out the neighborhood buildings, and Kelly begins her hunt for Zack.

episodes.name: Fort Defiance
episodes.summary: Gus and Vaun wage an attack on Palmer as Eph struggles to connect with Zack. Councilwoman Justine Faraldo vows to bring her extermination policies to the other boroughs.

episodes.name: The Silver Angel
episodes.summary: Eph and Nora finally see their lethal virus in action. Fet takes the security of Red Hook into his own hands while Dutch and Setrakian set off for Staten Island to question Fitzwilliam, Palmer's former bodyguard.

episodes.name: Quick and Painless
episodes.summary: Eph changes his appearance to leave the city while Nora is left as the reluctant parent for Zack. Dutch and Nora make a deal with Justine to secure Fet's release from jail.

episodes.name: Identity
episodes.summary: Eph concocts a plan to make and distribute a bioweapon. Gus realizes Angel can be an unlikely ally, and Kelly comes after Nora and Zack.

episodes.name: The Born
episodes.summary: Setrakian and Fet use Fitzwilliam's info to attack the Master, but a mysterious new player arrives. Dutch receives a surprise guest. Eph returns to NYC frustrated but energized to go after the one person responsible for killing his friends.

episodes.name: Intruders
episodes.summary: Eph must protect Zack against a surprise intruder into Red Hook. Gus convinces the Guptas to make a difficult choice. Fet and Setrakian set out to acquire the Lumen but discover they are not the only potential buyer.

episodes.name: The Battle for Red Hook
episodes.summary: Justine takes drastic measures to counter a surprise invasion. Nora and Fet perform a useful mission while Eph and Setrakian face off against an old foe.

episodes.name: The Assassin
episodes.summary: Dutch helps Eph attempt to assassinate Eldritch. Meanwhile, Abraham, Vasiliy, and Nora search for Rudyard Fonescu and the Lumen, while Justine tells the Upper East Siders the price they have to pay for her help.

episodes.name: Dead End
episodes.summary: Eichhorst relives his past while torturing Dutch in the present, while Vasiliy and the others try to find their friend. Meanwhile, Abraham finally meets Rudyard, and Gus and Angel take the Guptas to safety.

episodes.name: Fallen Light
episodes.summary: Eph makes arrangements to get the bioweapon to Justine, in return for travel permits to get Zack to his grandparents. Meanwhile, Eichhorst warns Eldritch that the white's effects are temporary, and Gus and Angel travel to Rikers to get a new attack squad for Quinlan.

episodes.name: Night Train
episodes.summary: While Eph and Nora take Zack to the boy's grandparents, Abraham and Vasiliy prepare to bid for the Lumen against Eichhorst. Meanwhile, Quinlan and his Day-Hunters make their move.

episodes.name: New York Strong
episodes.summary: Vasiliy aids Navy SEALs trying to track down the Master, while Abraham and Quinlan try to translate the Lumen. Meanwhile, Eph returns to his home in the hopes that Zack will somehow make his way there, but Kelly arrives to make Eph an offer.

episodes.name: Bad White
episodes.summary: Eph approaches Abraham to find out what the Lumen tells about the Master's weaknesses, and Quinlan suspects treachery. Meanwhile, Kelly tends to her captive son and arranges his introduction to the Master. And a desperate Eldritch offers Abraham a deal in return for the secret of the white.

episodes.name: First Born
episodes.summary: Eph helps Quinlan steal the Lumen to draw the Master out. While Abraham and Vasiliy close in on their prey, Quinlan reviews how he came to be. Meanwhile, Gus convinces Angel to help him get Guadalupe to safety.

episodes.name: Gone But Not Forgotten
episodes.summary: Quinlan and Abraham realize that the Master still lives as long as his essence is at large. Meanwhile, Eichhorst takes control of the strigoi and launches a new attack on Justine and the NYC command structure.

episodes.name: Madness
episodes.summary: While Abraham and Quinlan search the Lumen for a way to defeat the Master, Abraham recalls his encounter with another strigoi in Amsterdam in 1972. Meanwhile, Eph and Dutch try to find a way to stop the strigoi from communicating, and Vasiliy discovers the new plan that the creatures are up to.

episodes.name: The Battle of Central Park
episodes.summary: Justine and her people launch a desperate attack on the strigoi nest below Central Park. Vasiliy takes an insertion team in, while the city has the convict teams sweep the tunnels. Meanwhile, Dutch and Eph try to hack the strigoi communication network, and discover that Zack is still alive.

episodes.name: Collaborators
episodes.summary: Vasiliy checks on his parents and makes a startling discovery. Meanwhile, Eph and Dutch convince Quinlan to accompany them on a trip to JFK to recover the black box from the Master's flight.

episodes.name: White Light
episodes.summary: Abraham and Vasiliy continue their hunt for the Old World Ancient. Meanwhile, Quinlan tells the Ancients about Abraham's plan, and Eph is forced to nurse Dutch back to health after her exposure to the Master's voice.

episodes.name: Do or Die
episodes.summary: With the strigoi ready to overrun the city, Vasiliy warns Dutch and Eph to get out. Meanwhile, Gus and Angel try to leave the city but run into Justine, and Eichhorst tracks down the cargo from the Aurora Cutlass.

episodes.name: The Fall
episodes.summary: It's the final showdown as the team tries to capture the Master and place him in the box. However, the fate of humanity lies in one boy's hands.

episodes.name: The Worm Turns
episodes.summary: Nine months after the warhead detonated in New York, the strigoi have formed a "partnership" with the humans, offering free medical care in return for blood donations. Eph is in Philadelphia trying to make a life for himself on the fringes, while Vasily and Quinlan try to acquire a nuclear warhead. Meanwhile, the Master plans to raise Zack as his next host body.

episodes.name: The Blood Tax
episodes.summary: The fates of Gus and Dutch are revealed, while Eph continues to help Alex and her brother.

episodes.name: One Shot
episodes.summary: While Vasiliy and Quinlan try to obtain a nuclear warhead, Eph leads a strike against the strigoi in Philadelphia... alerting the Master and Eichhorst to his presence. Meanwhile, Zack makes a new friend.

episodes.name: New Horizons
episodes.summary: Desai forces Dutch to help him calm down a woman undergoing C-section. Meanwhile, the underground takes a heavy blow and Eph and Alex learn of New Horizons.

episodes.name: Belly of the Beast
episodes.summary: While Vasiliy and Quinlan acquire the nuclear pit from the strigoi convoy, Eph and Alex head for New Horizons to discover it's secret. Meanwhile, Dutch leads a rebellion and finds Abraham, while in the past, Quinlan finds a moment of happiness.

episodes.name: Tainted Love
episodes.summary: Roman takes the others to meet with an old friend who can provide them with a plane and get the warhead to New York. Meanwhile, Zack learns a painful lesson about love.

episodes.name: Ouroboros
episodes.summary: Eph reunites with Abraham and Dutch, bringing Alex along with him. His health failing, Setrakian ignores Eph's warnings, pushing himself to the limit in his quest for victory and revenge. Fet and Quinlan race back to Manhattan. Meanwhile, Gus decides to help the resistance, but Creem goes to the Master with valuable information. Later, the Master seals off the city and prepares to eliminate them all.

episodes.name: Extraction
episodes.summary: Before he has Quinlan kill him, Abraham tells the others how to defeat the Master. They begin by assaulting the Partnership facility and capturing Desai. Meanwhile, the Master sends Zack on a special mission.

episodes.name: The Traitor
episodes.summary: The team threatens Selah to get leverage against Desai. Meanwhile, Eph tries to determine if Zack is working for the Master or not, while Gus goes to recover the nuke.

episodes.name: The Last Stand
episodes.summary: The team is forced to retreat, and Quinlan and Vasily come up with a plan to use the nuke to destroy the Master once and for all.

items.title: The Strain
items.summary: The Strain is a high-concept thriller that tells the story of Dr. Ephraim Goodweather, the head of the Center for Disease Control Canary Team in New York City. He and his team are called upon to investigate a mysterious viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism. As the strain spreads, Goodweather, his team, and an assembly of everyday New Yorkers wage war for the fate of humanity itself.

episodes.name: Phase Six
episodes.summary: Captain Tom Chandler and the crew of the USS Nathan James set out for the Arctic with two civilian virologists, Dr. Rachel Scott and Dr. Quincy Tophet, who claim to be studying birds. When they come under attack by a renegade team of Russian forces, Chandler learns these virologists are actually collecting samples of the source of a deadly virus that has wiped out over half the human population while they've been at sea. As they head home on the orders of the remaining U.S. government, Chandler and his crew realize that home is a shadow of what they left, and the safest place to develop a vaccine for this deadly disease is out at sea on their ship.

episodes.name: Welcome to Gitmo
episodes.summary: Chandler and his crew head to the U.S. Military base at Guantanamo Bay in hopes of collecting food, medical supplies and fuel replenishments. Three teams are dispatched to carry out these varied tasks. While there, they come under attack by escaped Gitmo prisoners and enlist the help of a grizzled private contractor who's been surviving for weeks and living off the land.

episodes.name: Dead Reckoning
episodes.summary: The James faces off against a new foe who demands Chandler hand over Rachel and her research. When Chandler refuses, he and his crew are put to the test as Chandler engages in a series of risky strategic moves. But it turns out their new enemy has his own horse in the race to find a cure for the virus.

episodes.name: We'll Get There
episodes.summary: Days after a trying series of events at Gitmo, Chandler and his crew are put under extreme duress when the ship's propulsion system suffers a catastrophic event. With Dr. Scott in danger of losing all her research on the virus and a crew overworked, overtired and desperately low on drinking water, Chandler's leadership and ingenuity are put to the test.

episodes.name: El Toro
episodes.summary: With Rachel close to a breakthrough on her vaccine, she, Chandler and XO Slattery lead a small team into the jungles of Nicaragua on a mission to find monkeys for her vaccine trials. While there, they find much more than they bargained for when they run across a former drug kingpin who will stop at nothing to maintain his stranglehold on his oppressed society. Chandler and his men find themselves in a huge moral dilemma over whether to eliminate this menace or take what they need and continue on with their mission.

episodes.name: Lockdown
episodes.summary: After returning from the horrors of Nicaragua, panic begins to spread throughout the ship when Lt. Danny Green comes down with a mysterious illness that could be the virus. Losing faith in Rachel and her failing vaccine trials, Chandler now has to deal with a restive crew. If he fails to keep the crew together, the whole mission is in jeopardy.

episodes.name: SOS
episodes.summary: After picking up a distress call near Jamaica, Chandler and a small team stage a rescue attempt. But a surprise attack leaves Chandler and Tex stranded at sea. Slattery and the crew search desperately to find their lost at sea Captain and his comrade, hoping to do so before their enemies beat them to it.

episodes.name: Two Sailors Walk Into a Bar
episodes.summary: With Chandler and Tex caught in a dangerous situation, Slattery has to step into the role as commanding officer. Torn between a mission with the fate of the world at stake and a Captain in danger, Slattery has to find a way to get his people back without losing the most important asset: the vaccine prototype.

episodes.name: Trials
episodes.summary: Rachel and Chandler ask for six volunteers to participate in human trials of her vaccine, but the tests could be a living hell as the virus and the vaccine do battle inside their bodies. Meanwhile back in the States, Chandler's wife and father are doing everything they can to keep their family alive.

episodes.name: No Place Like Home
episodes.summary: Chandler and his crew finally return home, where a former D.C. power player is fending off a dangerous warlord who threatens everyone's hopes of restoring law and order in society. Now with a location and a means to finalize their mission, Chandler sets out to find his family, only to discover something absolutely terrifying about this brave new world.

episodes.name: Unreal City
episodes.summary: After the horrifying revelations and reversals of fortune in Baltimore, Chandler and his fractured team join forces with an underground resistance in an attempt to defeat Amy Granderson. With doses of the cure running low, Rachel tries to do some good for the sick while remaining a prisoner at Avocet. Meanwhile, Slattery and the crew of Nathan James are in a race against time to save an injured Dr. Tophet and regain control of their ship.

episodes.name: Fight the Ship
episodes.summary: Rachel tries to help the sick while remaining a prisoner; Slattery and the crew try to regain control of their ship.

episodes.name: It's Not a Rumor
episodes.summary: Nathan James returns home to Norfolk on a mission to produce and mass distribute the cure. With his family now safely aboard the James, Chandler sends his crew in search of their own friends and loved ones. Who, if any, will find their families? And will those who do return to the ship?.

episodes.name: Solace
episodes.summary: The crew of Nathan James discovers that hospital ship USNS Solace was sent to sea to wait for Dr. Scott's cure. Captain Chandler sees an opportunity to add another ship to their fleet while Rachel is eager to find a lab better equipped to replicate the vaccine. When Solace fails to respond to radio communications, Chandler and his team board the ship..and come face-to-face with an unexpected enemy.

episodes.name: Achilles
episodes.summary: With a small group of survivors from Solace in tow, Chandler and his crew square off against an enemy of the most dangerous kind - a nuclear-powered submarine led by rogue British naval officers, Sean and Ned Ramsey. XO Slattery interrogates a captured mercenary from the hospital ship in an effort to extract information on the sub and its mission. As Nathan James engages in a perilous game of cat-and- mouse, the truth about the mercenary sub unfolds.

episodes.name: Long Day's Journey
episodes.summary: Chandler tracks the immunes to Northern Florida; Rachel comes across a secret formula that her mentor was working on; Chandler's team locates an immune compound.

episodes.name: Alone and Unafraid
episodes.summary: Slattery struggles to evade the sub; Chandler and the land team infiltrate the immune compound; Danny discovers that Niels is working for the Ramseys; Chandler manages to encroach Sean's inner circle.

episodes.name: Safe Zone
episodes.summary: While trying to piece together Dr. Hunter's lost formula, Rachel deals with the fact that her sworn enemy is on board the ship; Chandler tries to reverse the brainwashing Michener suffered at the hands of the Ramseys.

episodes.name: Uneasy Lies the Head
episodes.summary: With Dr. Scott on the verge of a breakthrough, Chandler and his team set out to land in search of much needed supplies and materials for her lab. Once there, Burk stumbles upon a gang of children who have been offered a bounty by the Immunes for information on the U.S. Navy. A vicious battle ensues when the Immunes come to collect their prisoners. Back on the ship, Rachel's efforts to produce a spreadable cure depend on Niels - her success now inextricably linked to the scientist who nearly erased mankind.

episodes.name: Friendly Fire
episodes.summary: Rachel is hard at work on a new, more efficient version of the cure while Alisha decodes a message found on a cell phone recovered from the Immunes on land. A suspicious death on the ship forces Chandler to launch a murder investigation, causing dissent among the crew and threatening to upset good order and discipline. Armed with new information provided by Michener, Nathan James heads to New Orleans, only to find that the Immunes have a terrifying surprise in store for them there.

episodes.name: Valkyrie
episodes.summary: Sean Ramsey broadcasts a message implicating the Navy in a devastating disaster. It's now more important than ever for Chandler to infiltrate their network and regain the trust of the American people. Nathan James locates the source of the Immune's signal - a mysterious oil platform in the middle of the ocean. Once there, Chandler and his team engage in a brutal battle with civilian forces who have aligned themselves with the Ramsey's plan.

episodes.name: Cry Havoc
episodes.summary: After retrieving the mastermind behind the Immune communications network, Nathan James finds itself trapped between the sub and civilian blockades set up by the Immunes. Chandler sends Dr. Scott and the cure off the ship under the protection of XO Slattery as the James heads towards its inevitable final showdown with the sub.

episodes.name: A More Perfect Union
episodes.summary: With their mission now fully dedicated to spreading the cure, Nathan James puts a call out to civilians to meet at pre-selected ports across the country, where all will receive the cure. However, small Immune factions remain active in their quest to fight the cure and fulfill Ramsey's dreams. Will Nathan James regain America's trust? Has the havoc and destruction caused by the Immunes ended all hope to spread the cure? Or will Nathan James prevail against the enemy and finally spread the cure?.

episodes.name: The Scott Effect
episodes.summary: CNO Tom Chandler is sent to Asia to investigate a possible mutation of the Red Flu. Captain Slattery and his crew deliver cure to Southeast Asia but there may be an unexpected threat in the region.

episodes.name: Rising Sun
episodes.summary: Chandler must find a way to return to his old crew and investigate a dangerous new foe.

episodes.name: Shanzhai
episodes.summary: Chandler and crew race to find answers in an Asian Dodge City. Slattery begins to unravel the truth about his troubling predicament.

episodes.name: Devil May Care
episodes.summary: Chandler must confront his suspected new foe. Slattery learns more about the supposed virus mutation. Pressure mounts on President Michener as the situation worsens

episodes.name: Minefield
episodes.summary: Chandler's mission becomes complicated as his position is worsened. President Michener faces pressure from the regional leaders

episodes.name: Dog Day
episodes.summary: Chandler's mission comes to a head as he prepares the final part of his plan. President Michener ponders the fate of his presidency.

episodes.name: In the Dark
episodes.summary: The Nathan James must evade an overwhelming threat. A revelation in St. Louis puts President Michener in a terrible position.

episodes.name: Sea Change
episodes.summary: America copes with tragedy while Chandler further investigates the possible virus mutation.

episodes.name: Paradise
episodes.summary: Chandler gets a lead that could help answer threatening questions. Kara does some digging in the White House.

episodes.name: Scuttle
episodes.summary: Chandler finds himself faced with a difficult decision when a strange order comes in from the White House.

episodes.name: Legacy
episodes.summary: Chandler comes face to face with his powerful enemy in a final showdown. Kara joins up with someone that can help with her mission.

episodes.name: Resistance
episodes.summary: Chandler returns to America to find out what has really been happening.

episodes.name: Don't Look Back
episodes.summary: The fight for America comes to an end; Chandler faces a challenge that could change his life forever.

episodes.name: In Medias Res
episodes.summary: Sixteen months after thwarting the coup in America, Nathan James must face yet another global disaster. The question remains, where in the world is Tom Chandler?

episodes.name: The Pillars of Hercules
episodes.summary: Having lost their only lead, the crew of Nathan James continues their search for an item that could save the world. Chandler immerses himself in a mission for revenge.

episodes.name: Bread & Circuses
episodes.summary: Nathan James's crew searches for a precious item leading them to a strange place of opulence and violence where they cross paths with a most unexpected ally.

episodes.name: Nostos
episodes.summary: The crew searches for one of their own as enemies close in on all sides. Slattery is haunted by visions of the past.

episodes.name: Allegiance
episodes.summary: Nathan James is diverted from their mission when they receive a suspicious distress call from a fishing trawler.

episodes.name: Tempest
episodes.summary: With an enormous storm on the horizon, Nathan James must navigate an equally terrifying threat in order to make it to safety.

episodes.name: Feast
episodes.summary: The search continues with a reconnaissance mission but things turn violent when an old foe resurfaces.

episodes.name: Lazaretto
episodes.summary: An undercover mission in the land of the dead leads to disturbing revelations about Dr. Vellek's sinister plans.

episodes.name: Detect, Deceive, Destroy
episodes.summary: The crew of Nathan James faces a threat that will test the limits of their Naval tactics and strategies.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.summary: Chandler confronts his enemy — and his personal demons — in a final showdown, with the fate of humanity on the line.

episodes.name: Casus Belli
episodes.summary: Three years after overcoming the global famine, the United States Navy is ready to unveil its first fully functional fleet since the Red Flu pandemic, but a new type of threat may mean the next world war.

episodes.name: Fog of War
episodes.summary: Thrust back to World War II era military technology, Nathan James must think fast to survive a fight with limited weapons capabilities.

episodes.name: El Puente
episodes.summary: With nations being rapidly occupied, Chandler tries his hand at diplomacy to unite two hostile countries so they can fight a common enemy.

episodes.name: Tropic of Cancer
episodes.summary: As Nathan James and her allies attempt to prevent the enemy moving north, Chandler's haunting visions manifest into reality.

episodes.name: Warriors
episodes.summary: After months of fighting, the crew of Nathan James must embark on a dangerous mission to secure important intel that could decide the fate of the war.

episodes.name: Air Drop
episodes.summary: Nathan James must seek the aide of a prominent rebel leader in order to create a staging area before mounting an invasion of their own.

episodes.name: Somos la Sangre
episodes.summary: Pinned down after days of fighting, Vulture team must find their way into a secretive enemy camp.

episodes.name: Honor
episodes.summary: With a devastating hostage situation occurring back home, Chandler must devise the perfect plan to avoid losing everything.

episodes.name: Courage
episodes.summary: The crew of Nathan James begin preparations for what may be their most ambitious mission to date.

episodes.name: Commitment
episodes.summary:
It is all out war as Chandler must face his fears and confront the greatest threat he has ever encountered.

Series finale

items.title: The Last Ship
items.summary: Their mission is simple: Find a cure. Stop the virus. Save the world. When a global pandemic wipes out eighty percent of the planet's population, the crew of a lone and unaffected Navy destroyer, the USS Nathan James, must find a way to pull humanity from the brink of extinction.
